jobs.title: Staff Product Manager
jobs.description:
Help make the world more hospitable

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

Some businesses run one location. Others run hundreds, across different brands, different owners, and different rules for what can be shared between them. Making one platform work brilliantly for both is a genuinely hard product problem and it's the one our team solves every day.

We're looking for a Staff PM to own a critical part of that problem end to end. This is a role where you set direction, build the case for what we invest in next, and raise the product craft of the team around you not just ship features. You'll work directly with a technical Director and a team that moves fast on problems that matter to businesses managing real scale.

Your mission, should you choose to accept it:

  • Own the product direction for how Mews serves multi-location and multi-brand businesses
  • Lead strategy and the investment case for some of our most ambitious product bets this year
  • Make the hard calls on complex trade-offs, in close partnership with senior engineers
  • Lead discovery that spans genuinely different customer types and turn it into a clear roadmap
  • Coach and raise the bar for the product managers and builders around you
  • Represent this product area in broader company planning and strategy

You'll be a great fit if you bring a few of the below with you:

  • 8+ years in product, including genuine Staff or Principal PM experience owning a full product domain
  • Strong technical fluency — comfortable as a peer to senior engineers, not just a translator
  • A track record leading complex, multi-stakeholder discovery and turning it into strategy
  • Experience building frameworks or standards that raise the product bar for a whole team
  • Comfortable with AI tools as a core part of how you work
  • Experience with multi-location, multi-brand or multi-entity SaaS platforms is a strong plus — hospitality experience is not required

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

Version control is a critical part of our IDEs, but we want to take it further. We’re turning VCS into a strategic product direction and, eventually, we aim to grow it into a dedicated ecosystem. This role exists to define what that future looks like right now.

As the Senior Product Manager, you’ll figure out where JetBrains should play in the VCS space, how to evolve our Git and code review experiences, and what new opportunities exist beyond our current tools.   • Listen closely to what the community and the industry are saying to figure out exactly what we should be working on. 
  • Align roadmap decisions across the product, engineering, design, marketing, developer advocacy, partnership, and customer-facing teams.

  • A data-informed approach, combining usage metrics, customer feedback, and market signals to make decisions.

  • Previous success leading the product direction and strategy for technically complex developer tools, SCM, CI/CD, or code collaboration software.

  • Experience bringing stakeholders together across product, engineering, marketing, and developer advocacy.

  • Based in the EU, ideally Munich, Prague, Amsterdam, Berlin, Belgrade, or remote within the EU, with the ability to travel to JetBrains offices as needed.
  • As a plus, familiarity with advanced version control scenarios, such as complex merges, monorepos, and enterprise/self-hosted setups.

Success means moving VCS from a platform subsystem to a clear, strategic ecosystem. Ultimately, you’ll earn your team's trust by making sound decisions, keeping projects moving, and leaving the product better than you found it.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (m/w/d) Creator Platforms
jobs.description:
Die campoint AG ist Technologiepartner und Betreiber einer der größten deutschsprachigen Plattformen für die Creator Economy und Digital Entertainment - von der Consumer-Plattform bis zur B2B-Infrastruktur, mit der Creators und Agenturen ihr Business aufbauen und steuern. Dabei sind Creators für uns keine User, sondern Unternehmer, deren Erfolg unmittelbar von unseren Produkten abhängt. Das bestimmt, wie wir priorisieren. Wir gestalten nach unserer Vision. Wir leben von Teamplay, Hands-on-Mentalität und einer Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe.

 Aufgaben

 Du bekommst echte Ownership für zugewiesene Produkt-Streams innerhalb unseres B2B-Portfolios. Das bedeutet: Du entscheidest, was gebaut wird und was nicht - auf Basis von Creator-Feedback, Umsatzdaten und strategischem Rahmen. Wir haben keine langen Abstimmungsrunden. Du bist das Quality-Gateway für Dein Team und Eure Releases.

 Du navigierst eigenständig durch ein komplexes Stakeholder-Umfeld. Wir erwarten, dass Du Konflikte direkt löst - nicht eskalierst.

 Die strategische Richtung gibt der Head of Product vor. Deine Aufgabe ist es, sie mit hoher Eigenständigkeit und Qualitätsanspruch umzusetzen und innerhalb Deiner Streams bessere Entscheidungen zu treffen, als wenn er sie selbst treffen würde.

 Das ist kein Stepping-Stone in die Produktstrategie. Das ist eine Rolle für jemanden, der im Operativen exzellent ist und das als Stärke sieht, nicht als Einschränkung.

 
 Du verantwortest Discovery, Priorisierung und Delivery in Deinen Produkt-Streams von Anfang bis Ende.

 Du übersetzt qualitative Creator-Insights und starke Signale direkt in mutige Entscheidungen - ohne Dich in endlosen Datenanalysen ("Analysis Paralysis") zu verlieren.

 Du schreibst klare Specs und Tickets, die ohne Nacharbeit ins Development gehen.

 Du erkennst, wann ein Prozess oder Sprint-Ritual der schnellen Problemlösung im Weg steht, und brichst es pragmatisch in Absprache mit dem Team auf.

 Du holst externe Impulse aktiv rein und arbeitest sie pragmatisch ein.

 Du behältst den Überblick über technische Abhängigkeiten, ohne Dich in ihnen zu verlieren.

 
 Qualifikation

 Must-haves: 

 
 Du hast 4–6 Jahre Erfahrung als PO oder PM in einem digitalen Produkt-Umfeld mit nachweisbarer Execution-Qualität, nicht nur Prozess-Compliance.

 Du baust Dir schnell echtes Verständnis von Plattform-Logik, Creator-Mindset und wirtschaftlichen Zusammenhängen auf.

 Du besitzt ein hohes UX-Gespür und ästhetisches Urteil: Du erkennst intuitiv gute Usability und kannst Design-Entscheidungen aus Creator-Sicht begründen, statt sie nur analytisch zu zerlegen.

 Du verfügst über eine wirtschaftliche und psychologische Intuition rund um Monetarisierung, Nutzerverhalten und Einkommenspsychologie.

 Deine Sprachkenntnisse: Deutsch fließend, Englisch working proficiency.

 
 AI-Skills: 

 
 Du nutzt AI-Tools (Claude Cowork, ChatGPT o.ä.) selbstverständlich für Discovery, Spec-Writing und Priorisierung - nicht als Spielerei, sondern um schneller zu besseren Entscheidungen zu kommen.

 Du bewertest AI-Output kritisch, statt ihn unreflektiert zu übernehmen - Du erkennst Halluzinationen und schwache Annahmen.

 Du verstehst, wo AI in unseren Produkten selbst Creator-Mehrwert schaffen kann und denkst das aktiv in Deiner Priorisierung mit.

 
 Nice-to-have: 

 
 Du besitzt Erfahrung mit Creator-/Freelancer-Plattformen, Subscription-Flows oder Content-Monetarisierung.

 Du hast bereits in einem regulatorisch komplexen Umfeld gearbeitet.

 Du verfügst über Erfahrung mit Prompt-Engineering oder dem Aufbau AI-gestützter Workflows/Agenten in Deinem bisherigen PM-Alltag.

 
 Benefits

 
 Flexibilität, die passt: Mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und der Option auf Remote-Arbeit gestaltest Du Deinen Arbeitstag so, wie er für Dich am besten funktioniert.

 Inspiration und Freiraum: Unser moderner Campus bietet nicht nur ein kreatives Arbeitsumfeld, sondern auch einen eigenen Outdoor-Bereich mit Grill- und Volleyballplatz – der perfekte Ort, um Energie zu tanken und neue Ideen zu entwickeln.

 Gemeinsam stark: Wir leben eine Kultur, die auf Wertschätzung, Vertrauen und Offenheit basiert. Flache Hierarchien und agile Strukturen sorgen dafür, dass jede Meinung zählt und wir auf Augenhöhe zusammenarbeiten.

 Bereit für Deinen Start: Ab Tag eins bist Du bestens ausgestattet. Topaktuelle Hardware, persönliche Welcome Bag und ein Onboarding, das Dich wirklich abholt.

 Dein Wachstum, unser Antrieb: Wir investieren in Deine Weiterbildung! Ob durch unser vielfältiges Trainingsangebot oder individuelle Fortbildungsmöglichkeiten – wir unterstützen Dich auf Deinem Weg.

jobs.title: Group Product Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Einleitung Bei Peter Park ist "Product" nicht einfach nur ein Unternehmensbereich. Hier trifft alles aufeinander: Wohin wir als Unternehmen wollen, was wir verkaufen, wie wir wachsen, was unsere Kunden erleben. Als Group Product Manager verantwortest du eine Product Area im Produktmanagement, führst ein Team von Product Managern und arbeitest täglich mit einem breiten Stakeholder-Feld zusammen. Wenn du wirklich gestalten und führen willst, ist das die richtige Stelle.

 Was ist Deine Aufgabe? People Leadership, Coaching & Culture: Du hast die volle disziplinarische Verantwortung für ein Team von 2–3 Product Managern und prägst die Teamkultur mit dem Ziel, wachsende Eigenverantwortung und Empowerment im Team zu entwickeln.
 Produktstrategie & Alignment: Du entwickelst und verantwortest die Strategie für deine Product Area und stellst das kontinuierliche Alignment mit unseren Unternehmenszielen sicher. Du managst den Produktlebenszyklus und pflegst den Product Governance Prozess – schnell liefern, ohne Qualität zu opfern.
 Business Impact & Markt: Du steuerst Ressourcen für maximalen Impact und bewertest und verbesserst kontinuierlich die Kundenzufriedenheit auf Area-Ebene. Dafür hast du Markttrends und den Wettbewerb stets im Blick.
 Stakeholder-Management: Du hältst für deine Product Area die Fäden zusammen und hast stets das große Ganze im Blick. Dabei kommunizierst du sicher mit unterschiedlichen Unternehmensbereichen und Managementebenen.
 

 Deine Fähigkeiten: Du bringst 7+ Jahre relevante Erfahrung als Senior PM, Lead PM oder Team Lead im Product Management mit – idealerweise in einem schnellwachsenden Start-up, Scale-up, SaaS- oder IoT-Umfeld.
 Du hast bereits Erfahrung in der disziplinarischen oder fachlichen Führung.
 Du hast eigenständig eine Produktstrategie auf Area-Ebene entwickelt und verantwortet – inkl. Roadmap-Planung.
 Du arbeitest sicher mit agilen Methoden und bist vertraut mit Outcome-Metriken und datenbasierter Entscheidungsfindung.
 Du verfügst über exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeiten für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen und eine ausgeprägte Fähigkeit zur internen Kollaboration.
 Du denkst unternehmerisch, übernimmst Ownership für komplexe Themen und verlierst dabei nie das große Ganze aus dem Blick.
 Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und verfügst über gute Englischkenntnisse.
 

 Work Setup: 40 Stunden pro Woche (Vertrauensbasis)
 Homeoffice Policy: 3 Tage im Office / 2 Tage remote
 Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag
 Arbeitsort: München
 Team: 6 Kolleg:innen
 

 Welche Vorteile bietet mir Peter Park? So sieht Dein Arbeitsalltag bei uns aus 
 Arbeiten mit Bergblick: Unser Büro in der Neuen Balan bietet mehr als nur moderne Ausstattung: Von der Dachterrasse aus genießt Du ein Alpenpanorama, im Sommer wird gemeinsam gegrillt, und unsere Teamevents sorgen für gute Stimmung.
 Teamgeist und Impact-Kultur: Bei uns zählt Deine Stimme! Wir leben flache Hierarchien und eine Kultur des "Du" vom ersten Tag an. Das bedeutet: kurze Entscheidungswege, direkter Austausch mit allen Ebenen und ein Team, das Dich aktiv unterstützt. Deine Ideen sind hier nicht nur willkommen, sondern werden gehört.
 Freiraum für Deine Ideen: Du übernimmst Verantwortung und kannst Deine Ideen aktiv einbringen. Wir fördern Deine Entwicklung – mit echtem Vertrauen in Deine Fähigkeiten.
 Das bieten wir Dir zusätzlich 
 Dein Plus: Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Corporate Benefits und Jobrad-Leasing – und on top wählst du selbst zwischen einem bezuschussten Deutschlandticket oder EGYM Wellpass
 Deine Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zur EU-Workation
 Dein Setup: Ein Onboarding, das dich direkt abholt, höhenverstellbare Tische und modernes Apple Equipment für deinen perfekten Start ab Tag eins
 Dein Wohlbefinden: Ein gesunder Energiekick durch kostenlose Snacks (Obst, Nüsse, Müsli), bezuschusstes Office-Catering und der wöchentliche Team-Lunch

jobs.title: Working Student Product Management Energy Products & Tariffs (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
1KOMMA5°

 At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

 We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market, in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

 Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow. 

 Become a part of our mission and learn about our Product & Tech team!

 Deine Position

 As a member of our Global Product Management Team for Energy Tariffs, you play an active role in a visionary and dynamic group committed to revolutionizing the global energy sector. Building upon our Heartbeat AI Platform, our mission is to develop energy tariff products across our core markets, take operational and commercial ownership of them, and shape new regulatory products end-to-end. You sit at the center of product, regulation, commercial, and operations, and turn a fast-moving energy market into customer value. In your role you will:

 
 Drive Your Own Initiatives: Take ownership of well-scoped topics within our energy tariff portfolio, from analysis to recommendation to implementation. You lead your own initiatives and are accountable for their outcomes.

 Contribute to Our Energy Tariff Products: Work on our dynamic electricity tariff products across core markets, driving product improvements, feature rollouts, and customer experience initiatives.

 Support Regulatory Product Launches: Contribute to the launch of new products driven by regulatory change (e.g. Direktvermarktung), helping translate regulatory requirements into concrete product decisions.

 Analyze & Improve Marktkommunikation Processes: Dive into our market communication workflows, identify inefficiencies, and drive initiatives that make our energy retail engine faster and more reliable.

 Monitor Performance & Iterate: Leverage customer feedback, competitive analysis, and market trends. Monitor KPIs to help optimize product adoption and overall customer satisfaction.

 Prepare & Present: Prepare and present findings and recommendations to relevant Product Managers and stakeholders.

 
 Dein Profil

 
 You are enrolled at a university for at least two more semesters and can support us 15-20 hours per week during the semester, with up to 40 hours per week during semester breaks

 You are studying Business, Economics, Engineering, Energy Management, or a comparable course of studies

 You have a keen interest in the energy market, energy tariffs, and the energy transition, with a strong motivation to drive impactful change

 You have experience with and enjoy working in Google Sheets/Excel: SQL or Python skills are a plus

 You are detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable managing multiple projects at the same time

 You are a problem solver, able to adapt to changing environments and stakeholder needs

 Previous experience in the energy sector, product management, or consulting is a plus, but we're happy to get you up to speed - motivation counts!

 Excellent language skills in English and German (both written and spoken)

 
 Benefits

 
 You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen

 With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate

 Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues

 You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers

 You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe's most thriving scaleups

 You can work in one of our offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich

 Flexible working hours that fit around your university schedule

 Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass

 Benefits and discounts are yours with Futurebens

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - New Business
jobs.description:
Location: Hamburg, Berlin or Barcelona

At Freenow, we are on a mission to empower smarter mobility decisions, helping people to move freely and cities to thrive. 

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Strategy & New Business team. You will own a vertical focused on complex, high-value order types, the kind that don't fit into a simple A-to-B booking and require real product thinking to scale. Think multi-leg journeys, recurring enterprise needs, scheduled operations, and bespoke partner requirements. This list is not exhaustive the space is wide and still being defined.

You will set the vision for your vertical, build the roadmap from scratch, and take full ownership of outcomes. This is not an execution role with a predefined plan. You are the one who creates the plan.

YOUR DAILY ADVENTURES WILL INCLUDE:

  • Define the product vision and long-term strategy for your vertical
  • Build and prioritize the roadmap based on commercial opportunity and operational impact
  • Write clear, detailed specifications that engineering teams can build from independently
  • Lead cross-functional alignment across Sales, Operations, Legal, and Core Tech
  • Identify and resolve ambiguity early in requirements, in processes, and in stakeholder expectations
  • Track KPIs and use data to validate direction and drive decisions

 

TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE:

  • 7+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years in a senior role 
  • Background in marketplace, or operations-heavy products B2B/B2C
  • Proven ability to define product vision and build strategy, not just execute one
  • Strong experience managing complex stakeholder environments across multiple teams
  • Comfortable working with incomplete information
  • Exceptional written communication, your specs and documents set the standard for the team
  • Self-directed and accountable: you own outcomes, not just deliverables
  • Fluent in English; German is a significant advantage

BENEFITS & PERKS IN A NUTSHELL:

  • Flexible working arrangements
  • LinkedIn Learning
  • Sabbatical & special leave policies
  • WeRoad partnership
  • Birthday, 24th + 31st December off
  • Short term EU work policy
  • Mobility Credit
  • Health Insurance
  • Employee assistance program
  

 

Plus more local benefits depending on your work location!

 

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION:

Freenow is an equal opportunity employer and we consider qualified applicants regardless of race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability or age.
We want you to grow and evolve, bring your true self to work. 

ABOUT FREENOW:

Freenow by Lyft empowers smarter mobility decisions, helping people to move freely and cities to thrive. Through our multi-mobility app, we feature broad options for everyone across 9 European markets and over 180 cities. Millions of passengers can access services including taxis, private hire vehicles, carsharing, car rental, e-scooters, e-bikes, e-mopeds, and public transport within a single app. 

In July 2025 Freenow was acquired by Lyft, a global mobility platform, which connects riders and drivers for billions of rides across North America and Europe. Together, Freenow and Lyft are creating a more caring and connected world, with transportation for everyone. We are a global, diverse, highly motivated, and collaborative team that strives for excellence and likes to have fun. Ready for your next ride?

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (VCS Ecosystem)
jobs.location: Amsterdam, Netherlands; Belgrade, Serbia; Berlin, Germany; Limassol, Cyprus; London, Spain; Munich, Germany; Paphos, Cyprus; Prague, Czech Republic; Remote, Germany; Warsaw, Poland; Yerevan, Armenia
jobs.description:
You know version control is more than just a subsystem. It’s the backbone of how teams build software. You’re ready to shape the future of code-change workflows, from local commits to AI-assisted reviews. If you’re excited by the challenge of turning a core IDE feature into a standalone ecosystem, this is for you.

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

Version control is a critical part of our IDEs, but we want to take it further. We’re turning VCS into a strategic product direction and, eventually, we aim to grow it into a dedicated ecosystem. This role exists to define what that future looks like right now.

As the Senior Product Manager, you’ll figure out where JetBrains should play in the VCS space, how to evolve our Git and code review experiences, and what new opportunities exist beyond our current tools. You’ll have the ownership to set a clear product vision that covers everything from complex local merges to remote, containerized, and AI-assisted workflows. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering and quality leads, as well as product marketing, developer advocacy, and the IntelliJ Platform teams. Together, you'll figure out how to handle the next era of software delivery, including tracking provenance and reviewing AI-generated changes across different environments.

Day to day, you will:

  • Set the long-term product strategy for VCS and code-change workflows across all JetBrains IDEs.
  • Identify gaps in current developer workflows and define new product directions in the VCS space.
  • Explore new opportunities, from cross-IDE VCS clients and host-neutral code reviews to AI-native review and authorship tracking.
  • Listen closely to what the community and the industry are saying to figure out exactly what we should be working on. 
  • Align roadmap decisions across the product, engineering, design, marketing, developer advocacy, partnership, and customer-facing teams.
  • Work with engineering and quality leads to balance user value, technical constraints, and platform health.
  • Shape external positioning and represent our VCS direction in conversations with customers and the broader developer tools community.

What you’ll bring

  • A collaborative mindset that works well with engineering and quality teams on deeply technical challenges.
  • Strong product judgment, especially when navigating ambiguous areas to define a new ecosystem.
  • The ability to think beyond existing boundaries and spot opportunities for entirely new workflows.
  • Clear communication skills, whether you’re aligning internal stakeholders or talking to deeply technical users.
  • A data-informed approach, combining usage metrics, customer feedback, and market signals to make decisions.
  • An interest in how AI is changing software development, from generated commits to AI-assisted reviews.
  • A drive to improve solutions instead of copying what already exists.

What you’ll need

  • Previous success leading the product direction and strategy for technically complex developer tools, SCM, CI/CD, or code collaboration software.
  • The proven ability to translate intricate developer workflows into clear product roadmaps.
  • Experience bringing stakeholders together across product, engineering, marketing, and developer advocacy.
  • A deep understanding of version control mechanics, code-change workflows, and how developers actually ship code.
  • Based in the EU, ideally Munich, Prague, Amsterdam, Berlin, Belgrade, or remote within the EU, with the ability to travel to JetBrains offices as needed.
  • As a plus, familiarity with advanced version control scenarios, such as complex merges, monorepos, and enterprise/self-hosted setups.

What success looks like

Success means moving VCS from a platform subsystem to a clear, strategic ecosystem. You’ll have built a compelling product vision that engineering teams are aligned on and customers are excited about. You won’t just be copying what exists. You’ll be finding entirely new ways to solve code-change workflows, especially as AI becomes a bigger part of development. Ultimately, you’ll earn your team's trust by making sound decisions, keeping projects moving, and leaving the product better than you found it.

Why join JetBrains?

  • Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
  • Flexible work schedu

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Us 

 Canary Technologies is changing the game for hotels with modern software powered by Canary's hospitality-specific AI platform. 

 

 Canary is utilized by 20,000+ hoteliers in 100+ countries to equip hoteliers with the technology they need to work smarter and wow their guests. Major hotel brands such as Wyndham, Marriott, IHG, Four Seasons, Rosewood, and Best Western trust Canary to deliver results. 

 

 Canary was named a 2024 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ company, a Most Innovative Company by Fast Company and a HotelTechReport Best Place to Work — and is backed by top Silicon Valley investors like Y Combinator, F-Prime, Brighton Park Capital and Insight Partners. 

 

 Join us in shaping the future of hospitality! 

 
 

 
 About the Role

 Canary is at the forefront of providing AI-powered technology solutions to the hospitality industry. Our mission is to help hotels modernize operations, enhance guest experiences, and drive business results through intuitive, digital-first products. Our innovative platform is trusted by hotels worldwide for its ability to streamline operations and improve guest satisfaction.

 We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our growing team and help lead the development of impactful products across key areas of our platform. In this role, you’ll take ownership of complex problem spaces, work closely with cross-functional partners, and drive initiatives that are critical to Canary’s continued growth and customer success.

 You’ll have the opportunity to work on a variety of high-leverage product areas , such as:

 
 Guest communication

 Digital check-in

 Payments

 Upsells

 And more!

 
 As part of a globally distributed team, you’ll collaborate regularly with colleagues and customers across time zones—so flexibility, asynchronous communication, and strong cross-cultural collaboration skills are essential.

 If you are a strong product thinker with at least 5 years of product management experience , and you’re excited to help shape the future of hospitality tech, we’d love to connect.

 Responsibilities 
 

 Define and execute product strategy, roadmap, and delivery plans for the Canary platform.

 Partner with Engineering and Design teams to bring intuitive, scalable, and reliable features to life.

 Collaborate with stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing to ensure successful product launches and strong customer adoption.

 Conduct in-depth customer research and product analysis to inform prioritization and uncover new opportunities.

 Translate complex customer and business needs into clear product requirements and user stories.

 Set clear goals and success metrics, and use data to drive continuous improvement and iteration.

 Help mentor product managers and contribute to the broader product culture and processes.

 Qualifications 

 5+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS or a technology-driven environment.

 Proven ability to define and ship successful products that deliver measurable business outcomes.

 Strong product intuition and customer empathy—you understand how to solve real problems with elegant, user-focused solutions.

 Experience working closely with Engineering and Design teams to drive execution in an agile environment.

 Skilled at making data-informed decisions while remaining grounded in customer feedback.

 Comfortable operating in a high-growth, fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.

 Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical audiences.

 Experience working across time zones within globally distributed teams.

 Bonus : Experience in hospitality technology, messaging platforms, payments, or AI/ automation is a plus.

 EU Compensation 
 
 Target cash compensation ranges from €140,000 - €175,000, including a fixed annual salary and a performance-based bonus paid quarterly. 

 This role also includes a stock option grant, subject to board approval. 

 Actual compensation will be commensurate with the candidate's skill level, experience, and specific work location. 

 We also work hard to ensure Canary is a fun and exciting place to work! Here are some of the additional benefits:

 

 Canary Days: As a company we want to ensure that the team has time to recharge. Each month we provide company wide days off to ensure there is at least one extended weekend or day off.

 

 Self Improvement Club: We meet each month and share our personal goals for the month. Each individual is provided a budget towards any purchases that help us achieve these goals.

 

 Professional Development Chats: We provide budget to help drive cross functional professional development conversations across the organization.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
You will own the roadmap for a core part of Diligent’s governance, risk and compliance SaaS platform, shaping how senior leaders and boards collaborate, communicate and make decisions in a secure, modern way. You’ll turn customer problems and market insights into simple, impactful product experiences, and work closely with engineering, design, and go‑to‑market teams to bring them to life. 

In this Senior Product Manager role, you’ll spend your time deeply understanding customer needs, prioritising what truly moves the needle, and defining clear success metrics for everything you ship. You’ll lead a cross‑functional squad, manage the product backlog, and launch features that drive engagement, adoption and measurable outcomes for our customers across the Diligent Platform. 

Here’s a breakdown of what you’ll do (not all of it, just the important stuff) 

  • Own and continuously refine the product roadmap for your area, using customer insight, data and market trends to prioritise what to build next. 
  • Define and drive product strategy that aligns with Diligent’s vision for modern governance, connecting your roadmap to clear business and customer outcomes. 
  • Act as the voice of the customer: run discovery, validate problems and solutions, and translate insights into clear user stories and product requirements.

jobs.title: Growth Product Manager
jobs.description:
About ScholarshipOwl

 ScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the U.S., connecting over 14 million Gen Z students with private scholarships — and the brands that power them. Our mission is to make education financing more accessible and engaging, while giving brands a way to connect with the next generation.
 We’re powered by AI technology that simplifies scholarship discovery, streamlines the application process, and delivers measurable results for both students and partners. Whether it’s helping students secure funding or enabling brands to run impactful campaigns, we’re reshaping how education is funded — and discovered.

 The Role
 
 We’re looking for a Growth Product Manager to take full ownership of the conversion engine at ScholarshipOwl, from the first visitor touchpoint through to a paid subscription. This is a high-impact, high-velocity role for someone who lives in the data, thrives on experimentation, and values action over perfection. 
 You will be the architect of our growth. You’ll spend your days identifying leaks in the funnel, hypothesizing solutions, and working alongside a dedicated pod of engineers and designers to ship experiments that move the needle on revenue and retention. If you are a "full-stack" growth thinker who can move from a Mixpanel cohort analysis to a detailed technical spec this is the role for you.

 What You’ll Do
 
 Own the Conversion Engine: Take end-to-end responsibility for the user journey, optimizing every step from landing page registration to paywall conversion and subscription retention.

 Drive the Experiment Roadmap: Build, prioritize, and maintain a high-tempo experimentation backlog. You will use frameworks (like ICE or RICE) to ensure we are always working on the highest-leverage growth bets.

 Analyze & Diagnose: Monitor funnel and retention metrics daily in Mixpanel. You’ll identify exactly where users are dropping off and perform deep-dive discovery to understand the why .

 Ship with Velocity: Write precise product specs and acceptance criteria that allow engineering and design to execute independently. We prioritize shipping "good enough" tests today to get data, rather than waiting for "perfect" features next month.

 Optimize Revenue Levers: Design and run pricing, paywall, and offer optimization tests. You’ll also evaluate new growth levers like organic loops, landing page personalization, and winback programs.

 Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Lead a dedicated pod of engineers and designers, maintaining strong working relationships with our dashboard and B2B teams to drive unified sprint priorities.

 Continuous Discovery: Conduct meaningful customer discovery interviews with our Gen-Z audience to uncover behavioral insights that data alone can’t show.

 What We’re Looking For
 
 4+ years of Product Management experience , specifically in a **Growth-**focused role.

 Experimentation Mastery: Proven track record of designing, running, and analyzing A/B tests that resulted in measurable improvements to business KPIs (CVR, ARPU, Churn).

 Data Fluency: You are a power user of product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar). You don't wait for a data analyst; you find the answers yourself.

 SaaS/Subscription Expertise: You understand the nuances of subscription models—trial-to-paid transitions, renewal cycles, and friction-point reduction.

 Technical Precision: Ability to write clear, "dev-ready" product specs and acceptance criteria. You understand technical trade-offs and how to scope an MVP.

 Mentoring & Leadership: A mentoring and knowledge-sharing mindset with a desire to level up the broader team on growth methodologies and experimentation rigor.

 Gen-Z Empathy: You have an intuition for (or experience with) B2C products targeting younger audiences and understand their unique digital behaviors.

 Growth Mindset: You are comfortable with ambiguity, fast-moving environments, and the fact that 70% of experiments might fail—as long as we learn from them.

 Bonus Points:
 
 Experience with payment platforms (Stripe, Braintree) or Figma/prototyping tools.

 Knowledge of lifecycle/email marketing , SEO , and paid acquisition channels.

 Growth-focused certifications (e.g., Reforge).

 Background in EdTech or student-facing products.

 Why Join ScholarshipOwl?
 
 Mission-Driven Work – Build technology that helps students unlock education opportunities.

 Fully Remote – Work from anywhere while collaborating with a global team.

 High Impact & Ownership – You aren't just a cog in a machine; you own the revenue engine.

 Unlimited PTO – We value results over hours worked and trust you to manage your time.

 Coworking Budget – $200/month to invest in your ideal coworking workspace.

 Continuous Learning Culture – We support curiosity, experimentation, and growth.

 Annual Company Off-sites – Connect with your teammates in person at various locations around the globe.

 

 Ready to move the needle? Apply now and show us how

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, SAP
jobs.description:
FloQast is at the forefront of the accounting industry, providing an AI-powered Accounting Transformation Platform created by accountants, for accountants. We are dedicated to revolutionizing how accounting and finance teams work, enabling them to move beyond manual, tedious tasks and into a strategic, advisory role. By leveraging our groundbreaking, auditable AI Agents and purpose-built solutions, we empower teams to streamline their financial close, enhance compliance, and achieve a new level of transparency and accuracy. Our mission is to help accountants reclaim their time, simplify their work, and ultimately shape the future of their profession. Come join us!

 FloQast's SAP integration is central to making FloQast the home base for accountants at SAP-running companies. You will own the product strategy and execution for that integration - ensuring FloQast workflows, playbooks, and products run cleanly on SAP data and processes. You will operate at the intersection of deep SAP technical knowledge and accounting domain expertise, working across Product, Engineering, customers, and GTM to drive adoption and expand FloQast's footprint in the SAP ecosystem. 

 Visa sponsorship is NOT available at this time 

 What You'll Do 
 
 
 
 Define and drive product functionality for FloQast's SAP integration, ensuring FloQast workflows, playbooks, and products are fully enabled by SAP financial data and processes. 

 
 Own the end-to-end integration design: connectivity patterns, data extraction methods (ABAP, oData, BTP), and how SAP financial data maps into FloQast's canonical models. 

 
 Navigate SAP deployment models — On-Premise, Private Cloud, Public Cloud (RISE/GROW), and HEC - to ensure FloQast's integration strategy covers the full range of customer environments. 

 
 Translate SAP FI-CO process knowledge (period-end close, subledger reconciliation, journal entries, controlling) into FloQast product requirements and integration designs. 

 
 Partner with Engineering on technical implementation, acting as the product authority on SAP data structures, configuration dependencies, and integration constraints. 

 
 Engage directly with customers and partners to understand SAP-specific needs, validate integration designs, and support successful deployments. 

 
 Support GTM teams with the FloQast-SAP value story: what the integration enables, how it accelerates close, and where it delivers measurable value for SAP-running accounting teams. 

 
 Drive adoption of FloQast workflows, playbooks, and products in SAP environments - with success measured by processes running on data from SAP ERP. 

 

 What You'll Bring 
 

 5+ years working in an SAP FI-CO environment supporting financial close activities, in a techno-functional, product, consulting, or solution advisory capacity. 

 Deep understanding of SAP FI-CO: general ledger, accounts payable and receivable, asset accounting, cost center accounting, and the period-end close cycle. 

 Hands-on familiarity with SAP technical architecture: ABAP, oData services, and SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform). 

 Understanding of SAP deployment models - On-Premise, Private Cloud, Public Cloud (RISE/GROW), and HEC - and how each affects integration approach and data availability. 

 Strong grasp of accounting processes, close cadences, and financial controls as they operate within SAP environments. 

 Ability to engage at both the technical and business level: credible with Engineering on integration architecture, and persuasive with customers on process value. 

 Equal comfort as a hands-on builder (requirements, integration design, specs) and a storyteller (GTM narrative, customer conversations, partner alignment). 

 Nice to Have 

 Experience with financial close software products such as FloQast, BlackLine, or similar. 

 Familiarity with SAP S/4HANA migration patterns and the differences in data model and integration approach versus ECC6. 

 Product management experience in a B2B SaaS company, or experience working closely with product teams to translate SAP domain expertise into product direction. 

 #LI-BT1
#LI-Hybrid 
 

 

 About FloQast:

 FloQast is the leading AI-powered Accounting Transformation Platform, uniquely built by former accountants for accountants. We automate complex, recurring accounting workflows—transforming preparers into strategic reviewers and relieving accountants from tedious manual work. Our cloud-based solution is trusted by over 3,500 world-class accounting teams, including Lululemon, Doordash, and the MLB, to drive collaboration and financial accuracy. Driven by a mission to continuously elevate the profession, FloQast is redefining both the practice and the perception of accounting on a global scale.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Local Payments
jobs.description:
At PPRO, we simplify access to local payments - providing a local payments platform that empowers giants like PayPal, Stripe, and Microsoft to connect with billions of consumers worldwide. We are on an ambitious, fast-paced mission to 3x our growth by 2028 - and we’re just getting started.

Our magic lies in our team of proud payments nerds. Spanning over 50 nationalities across 10+ global locations, our diverse cultures aren't a checklist; they are the competitive advantage driving our innovation. This is a people-first, high trust environment where you’ll have the autonomy to make a massive impact, own your work end-to-end, and grow through broad exposure, meaningful challenges, and continuous learning. We get things done, challenge respectfully, put the customer first, and recognise that our biggest successes are those we create as a team. If you’re ready to leave your footprint on global commerce, join us.

 
 

 

 The Purpose: 
 

 
 As a Product Manager in PPRO’s Local Payments Domain, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the payment experiences for our customers and partners, ensuring seamless, compliant, and efficient access to local payment methods. You will drive product discovery and delivery, working at the intersection of Engineering, Marketing, Risk, and Commercial teams to enable seamless adoption of local payment methods to some of the world’s leading fintechs, PSPs, and merchants. 

 Product Managers at PPRO have the passion and abilities for ensuring that we focus our time and energy on building the right things for our customers. You will inform the strategy, communicate with all relevant stakeholders and lead effective product discoveries with your team. Our mission is to make local payment methods as ubiquitous and accessible as credit cards. You will own and develop a portfolio of Local Payments integrations, engaging with schemes, defining a strong value proposition, and validating and setting success metrics. 

 In this impactful and highly visible role, you will own key business opportunities and product initiatives related to the portfolio, orchestrating flows, fine tuning the user experience, and co-creating new features together with the schemes and our customers. Your work will directly impact PPRO’s ability to scale globally by increasing adoption, improving success rates, and driving the commercial and technical integration of high-value local payment products. 

 What You Will Be Doing 
 
 
 
 Execute and inform our product strategy for our local payments portfolio from scheme engagement to product feature development and market launch. 

 
 Drive product discovery and delivery - collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to develop innovative, "Better-than-direct" payment experiences that drive value for our business and customers. 

 
 Develop and optimise the payments product portfolio that balances scheme requirements, financial efficiency, and high success rates for consumers and merchants. 

 
 Work hands-on with data - analyze key business opportunities and success metrics related to payment acceptance rates, scheme performance, and financial flow efficiency to drive meaningful outcomes. 

 
 Define clear success metrics and KPIs to measure payment method efficiency, automate reporting, and enable data-driven decision-making. 

 
 Collaborate cross-functionally – work closely with Compliance, Risk, Sales, and Customer Success teams to refine payment requirements, implement new features, and understand business needs. 

 
 Inform the roadmap planning and lead the execution for key initiatives, such as the strategic integration of new local payment methods, optimization of existing flows, and co-creation of new products with schemes. 

 
 Be a thought leader in local payments – stay ahead of regulatory changes, market trends, and best practices to keep PPRO at the forefront of effective, efficient, and accessible payments across the world. 

 

 What Success Looks Like 
 
 
 
 Improved adoption and financial performance of the local payments portfolio through optimization and strategic feature releases. 

 
 Higher payment success rates and fewer manual interventions for payment flows. 

 
 Seamless integration and expansion of new local payment methods and features into the core PPRO platform, replacing legacy integration methods. 

 
 Clear, data-driven insights into payment performance (acceptance rates, authorization rates, scheme metrics), with real-time visibility for internal stakeholders. 

 
 Positive feedback from customers and partners on the functionality, reliability, and value derived from the local payment methods. 

 

 What We Are Looking For 

 
 Product Leadership: Proven experience owning a product or feature set, leading product discovery, and executing successfully in a fast-paced environment. 

 
 Strong Analytical Mindset: Ability to work with data, define KPIs, and drive decisions based on insights rather than intuition.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Short Description SPREAD builds engineering intelligence for the world's most complex products. Our AI-native platform gives automotive OEMs, defense primes, and industrial manufacturers a single source of product truth so engineering teams can make confident product decisions, fast. We work with companies like Volkswagen, BMW, Mercedes, Bosch, Stadler, and Rheinmetall. Backed by HV Capital, DTCP, La Famiglia / General Catalyst, and Salesforce.

In this role, you own how SPREAD is positioned, messaged, and understood by engineering leaders at enterprise accounts. You translate a deeply technical product into narratives that win deals, arm Sales with competitive intelligence and enablement assets, and partner with Product and Engineering on go-to-market. This is a hands-on role in a small, senior marketing team alongside Growth, GTM Ops, and Design. 

 Your Mission Own positioning and messaging for SPREAD's platform, turning engineering intelligence into value propositions that land with top engineering leaders.
 Build and maintain competitive intelligence across the PLM and engineering data landscape and turn it into battle cards and objection-handling guides that Sales uses daily.
 Create sales enablement assets that shorten enterprise sales cycles and improve win rates.
 Partner with Product and Engineering on go-to-market for product releases, connecting every launch to a measurable customer outcome.
 Develop thought leadership content that builds credibility with deeply technical audiences.
 Partner with Growth and GTM Ops on campaign messaging and account targeting so demand gen speaks the right language to the right pain points.
 Represent SPREAD at industry events and customer conversations where engineering leaders expect a peer-level discussion about their domain.
 

 Your Experience 5+ years in B2B product marketing or technical product management for enterprise software or complex technical products, with hands-on ownership of positioning, messaging, and go-to-market.
 Technical fluency through an engineering or technical degree, or through deep experience managing or marketing highly technical products. You can hold a credible conversation about data architectures, PLM tool landscapes, or software-defined product development.
 Experience building sales enablement for complex enterprise deals (€100K+ ACV, 6-12-month cycles, multi-stakeholder buying committees).
 Strong competitive intelligence instinct. You track competitors, articulate differentiation in the buyer's language, and prepare sales teams for live objection handling.
 AI-native working style. You use AI tools daily to scale your output, from content creation to research to workflow automation. SPREAD is an AI-first company, and every team member operates accordingly.
 Identity as a product marketer. You partner with Product and Engineering, you speak their language, but your craft is marketing, not roadmaps or feature specs.
 Native or near-native English. Working-level German minimum. If German is your native language, strong English is sufficient.
 Based in Berlin or close enough for regular in-office collaboration, especially during the first months.
 

 Why SPREAD? Work on Agentic Engineering Intelligence that helps leading manufacturers master software-defined complexity. You market technology that engineering leaders genuinely care about.
 High ownership and measurable impact. You connect your positioning directly to deal outcomes and pipeline.
 A senior team that values craft, speed, and accountability over process and hierarchy.
 Strong overall package including attractive compensation and an annual learning budget.
 Mobility and wellbeing support through a Deutschlandticket mobility budget, bike-leasing and an Urban Sports partnership.
 Time off and flexibility with 30 vacation days, workation options, and one paid volunteering day per year.

jobs.title: Product Owner (all genders) – Big Data & Security
jobs.description:
Willkommen bei baramundi! "Wo Cloud, Security und Daten zusammenkommen, entsteht die Zukunft unserer Produkte" 
 Der Software-Markt entwickelt sich rasant weiter – und wir gestalten diese Entwicklung aktiv mit. Für unser Research & Development suchen wir einen Product Owner oder eine Product Ownerin, der bzw. die gemeinsam mit einem festen Entwicklungsteam unsere Cloud-Lösungen weiter voranbringt und den baramundi Proactive Hub im Bereich Big Data & Security maßgeblich mitgestaltet. 
 Am Standort Augsburg arbeiten interdisziplinäre Teams aus Softwareentwicklung, Testing, Scrum Mastering, Product Ownership und Agile Coaching an den Software-Produkten von morgen – zu 100 Prozent made in Germany. Dabei geht es nicht nur darum, Anforderungen zu verwalten, sondern Produktideen in klare, umsetzbare Schritte zu übersetzen, technische Komplexität greifbar zu machen und echten Mehrwert für unsere Kunden zu schaffen. 
 Neben einem großartigen Team bieten wir dir die Möglichkeit, hybrid zu arbeiten, aktiv an der Produktentwicklung mitzuwirken und deine Ideen jederzeit einzubringen. 

 Tu, was du am besten kannst: SECURITY & COMPLIANCE INTELLIGENCE VORANTREIBEN Du verantwortest die Security-Säule des baramundi Proactive Hub – von Vulnerability Intelligence über Configuration Management bis hin zu Infrastructure Analytics. Du übersetzt komplexe Sicherheitsanforderungen in klare, umsetzbare Produktinkremente und stellst sicher, dass IT-Teams proaktiv über Risiken informiert und handlungsfähig gemacht werden  
 DATA LAKEHOUSE & BIG DATA MITGESTALTEN  Du treibst gemeinsam mit deinem festen Entwicklungsteam den Aufbau einer leistungsfähigen, skalierbaren Dateninfrastruktur voran – als Core-Enabler für alle datengetriebenen Features des Proactive Hub. Dabei bringst du die Verarbeitungsgeschwindigkeit und -qualität unserer Daten auf ein neues Level 
 
 PLATFORM & INTEGRATIONS WEITERENTWICKELN  Du gestaltest den Ausbau der Proactive Hub Plattform aktiv mit – durch Integration externer Tools, Drittsysteme und Schnittstellen mit dem Ziel, den Hub zum zentralen Knotenpunkt im IT-Management-Ökosystem unserer Kunden zu machen 
 
 KI ALS PRODUKTBESTANDTEIL DENKEN  Du gestaltest KI-gestützte Features aktiv mit – von intelligenter Anomalieerkennung über LLM-basierte Assistenzfunktionen bis hin zu datengetriebenen Empfehlungen, die IT-Administratoren proaktiv und handlungsfähig machen  
 MIT DEINEM TEAM LIEFERN  Du arbeitest eng mit deinem festen Entwicklungsteam zusammen, bist deren primäre Ansprechperson für inhaltliche und produktbezogene Fragen und stellst sicher, dass das Team fokussiert, informiert und befähigt arbeiten kann 
 
 BRÜCKE ZWISCHEN PM UND ENTWICKLUNG SEIN  Du arbeitest eng mit dem Product Manager und UX/Design zusammen, moderierst Anforderungsprozesse und sorgst dafür, dass die Produktvision im Entwicklungsalltag greifbar und umsetzbar bleibt
